provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium michiganense, plant_name_id 280003.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.9 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 1.05 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.9 m'.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 1.9 m

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 4-12 whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 4-12 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-13 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 4.6-15.3 x 0.6-2.3 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.6-2.3 cm wide, 3.5-13.7 times longer than wide

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade narrowly elliptic, occasionally linear or slightly lanceolate

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): more or less horizontal or ascending in sun, drooping at tips

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-11-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers more or less pendent, not fragrant

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth Turk's-cap-shaped; sepals and petals reflexed 1/4-2/5 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): reflexed 1/4-2/5 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): yellow-orange or sometimes orange-yellow or orange proximally, red-orange distally; drawn in the distal red-orange The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): yellow-orange or sometimes orange-yellow or orange proximally The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): with maroon, often large spots

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): maroon spots The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 5.5-9.3 cm, petals 5.3-9.1 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens moderately exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers magenta or occasionally pink-magenta The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 11-22 cm

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.8-5 x 1.5-2.6 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.5-2.6 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium michiganense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (mid Jun-Jul)
